report.summary_zh: 只读审核完成，发现2项中等问题。未知结果隔离、禁止自动重执行、queue权威及receipt按需修复的主要逻辑符合专项审核要求；对照cd9f454至7cadfd7，未发现放宽旧断言，新增测试包含调用次数、旧JSON字节及异常对象身份检查。但恢复分支和锁清理异常缺少覆盖，暂不建议将相关发现全部关闭。本次未执行任何测试：python命令不可用，直接运行已定位的Python312被拒绝访问，纯内存验证未能执行；原19项测试依赖临时目录，其中一项启动子进程，亦未运行。文档的19项通过属于历史声明，本次未独立确认。未改文件、联网、启动代理或访问生产DB、SMTP及凭据；CURRENT_STATUS.md和FILE_MANIFEST.md缺失。
report.summary_en: Read-only review completed with two medium findings. Core unknown-outcome quarantine, prevention of automatic re-execution, queue authority and selective receipt repair align with the storage audit. Comparing cd9f454 with 7cadfd7 revealed no weakened existing assertions; added tests check invocation counts, unchanged JSON bytes and exception identity. Recovery and lock-cleanup branches remain insufficiently covered, so the related findings should not all be closed. No tests executed: python was unavailable on PATH and launching the located Python312 executable was denied, preventing in-memory verification. The original 19 tests require temporary directories and one launches subprocesses; none ran. The documented 19-test pass remains historical and was not independently confirmed. No files changed, networking, agents, production DB, SMTP or credentials accessed. CURRENT_STATUS.md and FILE_MANIFEST.md were missing.

findings.detail_zh: recover_unknown以completed恢复developer时仅设置needs_review，不像cycle正常成功路径那样登记独立reviewer任务。若完成queue提交失败发生在首次审核任务入队之前，恢复后没有reviewer可派发，开发成果将停留在needs_review。现有显式completed恢复测试仅使用reviewer，未覆盖此分支。应复用固定审核任务映射，以去重方式登记审核任务，并补充developer恢复测试。
findings.detail_en: Recovering a developer with resolution completed only sets needs_review; unlike the normal cycle success path, it does not enqueue the independent reviewer. If the completion queue commit failed before the reviewer was first persisted, recovery leaves no reviewer to dispatch and the artifact remains stranded in needs_review. Existing completed-recovery coverage uses only a reviewer task. Reuse the fixed review-task mapping with deduplicated registration and add developer-recovery coverage.

findings.detail_zh: exclusive的finally无条件执行lock.unlink()；若queue写入或receipt写入已抛异常，随后锁删除也失败，调用方收到的顶层异常将变为锁删除异常，原异常及提交阶段附注仅保留在异常上下文中。atomic_json的临时文件清理已保护主异常，但外层锁清理仍可覆盖它。现有身份断言仅直接测试atomic_json，未经过exclusive。应保留正在传播的主异常并附注锁清理失败，补充组合故障测试；文档对主异常保留的描述应注明当前限制。
findings.detail_en: The exclusive context manager unconditionally calls lock.unlink() in finally. If queue or receipt persistence has already failed and lock removal also fails, the lock-removal exception becomes the top-level exception; the original error and commit-stage notes survive only in exception context. atomic_json protects its primary error during temporary-file cleanup, but the outer lock cleanup can still replace it. Existing identity assertions test atomic_json directly without exclusive. Preserve the active primary exception, annotate lock-cleanup failure, add combined-failure coverage and qualify the documentation until fixed.
